newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial buys 3 sites for $4.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: First Industrial buys 3 sites for $4.8 mln.

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc said Friday it has acquired three industrial properties in Wisconsin and Illinois for a total of about $4.8 million.

The company said it acquired a 59,075-square-foot light industrial property in LaGrange, Ill., for $2.5 million. The property is completely leased to a company that services and distributes color copiers.
"The building is leased to a credit tenant on an absolute net basis with six years remaining on the lease," First Industrial's regional investment officer A. Scott McGregor said.

In addition, First Industrial purchased a 39,800 square-foot light industrial property in Wauwatosa, Wis., for $1.4 million. The property is 100 percent leased to General Electric Supply, the company said.
A third light industrial property was acquired by First Industrial in Green Bay, Wis., for $880,000, the company said. It is 25,254 square feet and is 100 percent leased to General Medical Corp.
